main_text.p: Quare sicut in momento lumen per tota per-spicui substantiam, amoto opaco, diffunditur: ita econtrà opaco interposito, in momento rursus evanescit, ac fiunt Tenebrae: quae respectu corporis opaci, quod suà interpositione inter lucem & perspicuum illas efficit, umbra dicuntur.
Color est qualitas ostensiva simplex, ex opaci crassi pluris & perspicui paucioris coalitione emanans, corpus coloratum in perspicuo illuminato tantum modo visibile exhibens.
Extremus color est, qui multum de suorum principiorum altero, perspicuo aut opaco, participat.
Albor est color extremus, multum perspicui habens.
Quapropter hoc colore praedita corpora in perspicuo illuminato juxta alia collocata, ipsa quoq; aliquid luminis conferunt, maximeq; præ[?] aliis fiunt visibilia.
Nigredo est color extremus, multum opaci obtinens.
Hic igitur color non collustrat alia corpora, ut albor: sed potius obscurat, corpus q; nigrum minus visibile efficit.
Medius color est, qui de utroq; extremo participat.
Et est exacte medius, aut non-exacte.
Exacte medius est Rubor: ex æquali contempera-tio-

page.notes: Long s normalised to plain s throughout, as required. Uncertain readings: "præ[?]" (the printed abbreviation after "maximeq;" is unclear), and "æquali" (the word before "contemperatio" is hard to read). Italics on "Color", "Albor", "Nigredo", "aut" and the opening words of the Rubor paragraph are judged from the scan. The text continues on the next page after "tio-".
